const workdir = WORKDIR_FROM_PACKET;
const q = s => "'" + s.replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'";
const commands = load("capture_commands") || [];
async function captureNative(kind, argv, permission_mode) {
  const output_token_budget = 16000;
  const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd: argv.map(q).join(" "), workdir, login:false,
    sandbox_permissions:permission_mode, max_output_tokens:output_token_budget, yield_time_ms:30000});
  if (r.session_id !== undefined || r.exit_code !== 0 || !Number.isInteger(r.original_token_count) || r.original_token_count > output_token_budget)
    throw new Error("capture unavailable/failed/incomplete/truncated; preserve truthful refusal, not positive evidence");
  const retained = {kind,argv,exit_code:r.exit_code,permission_mode,raw_output:r.output,
                    output_token_budget,original_token_count:r.original_token_count};
  commands.push(retained); store("capture_commands",commands);
  return kind === "repository" ? r.output : JSON.parse(r.output);
}
async function actualClock(purpose) {
  const result = await tools.clock__curr_time({});
  const clocks = load("capture_clocks") || [];
  clocks.push({purpose,tool:"clock.curr_time",result}); store("capture_clocks",clocks);
  return result.current_time.replace(" UTC","Z").replace(" ","T");
}
async function createOriginal(absolutePath, value) {
  const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);
  await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: " + absolutePath + "\n+" + serialized + "\n*** End Patch");
}
